interactionSummary: The clearest favorable pattern was that memory foam cushion interaction with the nose leaned favorable (4 positive versus 0 negative reports).
The clearest caution was that vent interaction with the face leaned unfavorable (0 positive versus 5 negative reports).

interactionInsights.description: Reports about the memory foam cushion where it contacts the nose were mostly favorable for comfort: 4 positive, 1 mixed, and 0 negative across 5 reviews. This isolates a component-to-body interaction rather than general mask satisfaction.

methodology.overallScore: 60% normalized original reviewer star rating and 40% extracted overall-satisfaction sentiment. Both components require at least five reviews.
methodology.aggregation: Repeated claims are averaged within each review before review-level results are combined.
methodology.minimumEvidence: Findings require at least five distinct reviews.
methodology.limitations: Retailer reviews are self-selected and may not represent every CPAP patient. Text findings were extracted by an AI model and are not medical advice.
